notes:
November 20th 2026
Version 13.18.x (stable) / 13.19.x (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Score Editor: 8va and 8vb marks keep very high or low notes on the staff. (K,R)
* Score Editor: "Remove repeat start" in the Repeat menu. (K,R)
* Score Editor: a text box you moved stays when you delete its bar. (K,R)
* Score Editor: 2nd endings show their chord name. (K,R)
* Score Editor: remove bass note names from whole bars at once. (K,R)
* Score Editor: Space during the count-in no longer stops your take. (K,R)
* Score Editor: swing eighths written and played back evenly. (K,R)
* R-Editor: Apply & Save for a .UPG, and Export to UPG from the editor. (R)
* 8X/4X/EVO tree: Export starts in your UPG folder; the backup remembers its folder. (R)
* Windows: choosing a folder no longer freezes the app. (K,R)
* Menus: a click is no longer lost when a tooltip is showing. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
